notes: Accuracy: 25/25 sampled harvest rows re-fetched raw (SVA, Desart, IFPDA, IACA, myhanga; AACHWA PDF in excerpt mode): all names shown, all claims (existence or peak-body membership) supported. Only 6 distinct source pages back all 151 harvest rows, so the sample is effectively a check of 6 lists. Duplicates found across lists (see drop). Review flags (not counted wrong): Krakow Witkin Gallery, Peter Blum and Marlborough Graphics are on the SVA publishers list but are general galleries (Marlborough link goes to marlboroughgallery.com) - keep only if they publish editions; Fusui Gabo, Doi Sadaichi, Takamizawa, Yokohamaya, Kawaguchi are defunct historic houses (second-hand works only). Taller de Grafica Popular: second, non-museum page found - peoplesgdarchive.org/item/7093 ('first self-supporting art workshop in Mexico to create and publish their own work'); AIC artist page dates it 1937-2010 (defunct, second-hand). Index homonyms: 'Two Palms' exists in index as an A1 brand (different entity; add F2 row separately); 'Department 56' exists under B4 only - add F2 tag. Thin areas retried: ANKA (now done from the static 2018 Art Guide PDF: 36 new centres; guide is 2018, membership may have changed), Japanese publishers beyond Hanga (Takezasado, Mokuhankan, Benrido), Chinese New Year print workshops, Jingdezhen, Icheon, Huichol, Madhubani, Pichwai, Warli/Gond (Tribes India), Haiti (Jacmel, Croix-des-Bouquets), Ndebele, studio pottery (CPA/Contemporary Ceramics Centre), studio glass (London Glassblowing), photographs (AIPAD 49 specialist dealers, general galleries like Gagosian/Pace skipped), vintage posters (IVPDA members page is JS - only 2 member pages + Josef Lebovic reached), Russian lacquer, Inuit (Uqqurmiut), Maori (NZMACI), West/North Africa (Nike, Kane Kwei, Wissa Wassef), Vietnam (Dong Ho). Still blocked/thin: Ethiopian painting workshops (no named workshop on any fetched page; only generic church-painting articles); Persian miniature ateliers in Isfahan (region renown only, no named atelier page); Kalighat and Gond named cooperatives (only regions/individual artists, who belong to VE); Pichwai named workshop (Nathdwara renown page only; sellers found were general Indian art marketplaces MeMeraki/Studio3, not taken); Crafts Council directory lists individual makers (artists -> VE), not taken; East Asian calligraphy/seal makers (Xiling Seal Engravers' Society not reached); Korean studios named (Icheon region only); Shona stone sculpture (Tengenenge) not reached. Museum pages (Met, AIC, WMODA, LACMA, SFO Museum, FAMSF, Coptic Museum) were used only as standing or region renown, never as the sole basis for a brand. Seller self-praise rows carry tier 'listed'.
